description: This file defines a component for storing and managing device authentication tokens and related metadata in an Android application. It includes data classes, an interface, and a class implementing token storage logic with persistence using shared preferences, supporting operations like load, save, and clear tokens, along with normalization of inputs.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: Data class representing an authentication token, role, scopes, and timestamp for a device

classes.name: PersistedDeviceAuthMetadata
classes.description: Serializable data class for storing scopes and timestamp metadata associated with device auth tokens

classes.name: DeviceAuthTokenStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for loading, saving, and clearing device auth tokens

classes.name: DeviceAuthStore
classes.description: Implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore that uses secure preferences to persist device authentication data

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Loads a device authentication entry from persistent storage based on device ID and role

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Saves a device token and associated metadata into persistent storage

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes device token and metadata from persistent storage

methods.name: tokenKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key for storing the device token

methods.name: metadataKey
methods.description: Constructs a key for storing token metadata

methods.name: normalizeDeviceId
methods.description: Trims and lowercases the device ID for consistency

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims and lowercases the role string

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims, filters, de-duplicates, and sorts a list of scope strings
